prepare_vlm_dataset: create a VLMPreprocessor instance and call prepare to split and push a VLM dataset to the Hugging Face Hub
split_vlm_dataframe: use the VLMPreprocessor split method to divide a DataFrame into training and validation sets
validate_vlm_data_paths: instantiate VLMPreprocessor to validate training and validation data paths and required metadata files
process_vlm_metadata: call the _process_metadata method to read and validate a metadata.jsonl file for required columns
review_vlm_preprocessor: review the VLMPreprocessor class to understand how it handles image dataset preprocessing and column renaming
